name: legal-plugin
description: Legal research over national and EU law: legislation, case law and regulatory decisions, with linked sources.

interface.shortDescription: Research national and EU legislation and case law with linked citations.
interface.longDescription: DirectCase Legal Search connects Codex to legislation, case law and regulatory decisions of national and European law. It returns the wording of a provision held for a given date, looks up decisions by case number or ECLI, and links each result to its document so citations can be checked.
defaultPrompt: Find CJEU case law on the right to be forgotten and summarize the key holdings with citations
Quote Article 6(1)(f) GDPR and show how courts have interpreted legitimate interest
Check the case citations in this document against DirectCase sources
